# WuWa inventory regression inputs

`inventory-c1a0.xml` is an authored offline inventory fixture. Its first two
entries reuse the selected factual E1 lines in `evidence-2026-10-21.xml`; the
three synthetic entries add a preview, historical maintenance and non-calendar
merchandise. It is not a complete publisher capture or a rolling-count oracle.
`inventory-c1a0-expected.json` pins every ID, position, actual detail URL, decoded
title, complete available HTML and content hash. Expectations were checked with
Python's `xml.etree.ElementTree` plus `hashlib.sha256` over compact UTF-8 JSON
`[title, content]`, independently of the TypeScript discovery being tested.

`evidence-e1-golden.json` was executed using the unchanged code at starting main
`9aabb88a5ac7e4e46c1f782d115802ad4f992e16` and the existing E1 fixture (input hash,
context and truthful metadata are embedded). It pins the complete extraction,
eligible entries/hashes and a no-final-winner replay with unattached records and
diagnostics. It was not generated by the new inventory discovery. Existing E1
fixtures remain unmodified. The fixture date establishes only a capture day;
it does not invent a timestamp for synthetic or missing metadata.
